title: Population pharmacokinetics of enoxaparin in infants, children and adolescents during secondary thromboembolic prophylaxis: a cohort study
design_evidence: The present cohort study is an open-label, non-randomized, follow-up study in pediatric patients treated with enoxaparin for a first VTE
population: infants, children and adolescents (median age 5.9 years) receiving enoxaparin for secondary thromboembolic prophylaxis; 152 unselected newly ascertained pediatric patients with symptomatic VTE were enrolled
